description: Edit your entity's card metadata: name (≤32), ticker (2–10 A–Z0–9), description (≤1000, no promises of returns), links {website,x,telegram,docs} (https), images (≤4; https or png/jpeg/webp data URI ≤600 KB). Owner, JWT.
